integrity: The analytical proof covers all integers n>=3, 0<h<1 and all twists modulo 2pi/n. Numerical convex-hull checks are corroboration, not an infinite certificate. The regular octahedron special case and the general facet-hole correspondence are established prior knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to symmetric two-ring equal-population regular configurations on the unit sphere, not unrestricted configurations or unequal rings; no independent validation, no definitive historical-priority determination.
title: Sharp spherical covering by two twisted regular latitude rings
